title: Runtime Endianness Detection and Byte Swapping
description:
Embedded developers must frequently deal with mixed-endian architectures (e.g. little-endian Cortex-M core communicating with big-endian network equipment).

### Requirements:
1. `system_is_little_endian()`: Detect memory layout.
2. `bswap16(uint16_t x)`: Swap high and low bytes.
3. `bswap32(uint32_t x)`: Reverse all 4 bytes.
hint: For byte swapping without compiler intrinsics (`__builtin_bswap32`), use bit-shifts and masking.
